title: AppleCareCoverage.Attributes
description:
Attributes for an organization device’s AppleCare coverage resource.

Introduced in Apple Business API 2.6.

agreementNumber.description: Agreement number associated with device coverage. This field isn’t applicable for Limited Warranty and AppleCare+ for Business.

contractCancelDateTime.description: UTC date when coverage was canceled for the device. This field isn’t applicable for Limited Warranty and AppleCare+ for Business.

endDateTime.description: UTC date when coverage period ends for the device. This field isn’t applicable for AppleCare+ for Business.

isCanceled.description: Indicates whether coverage is canceled for the device. This field isn’t applicable for Limited Warranty and AppleCare+ for Business.

isRenewable.description: Indicates whether coverage renews after endDateTime for the device. This field isn’t applicable for Limited Warranty.

paymentType.description: Payment type of device coverage. Possible values: ‘ABE_SUBSCRIPTION’, ‘PAID_UP_FRONT’, ‘SUBSCRIPTION’, ‘NONE’

startDateTime.description: UTC date when coverage period commenced. For AppleCare+ for Business, it’s UTC date when a device enrolls into the plan.

status.description: The current status of device coverage. Possible values: ‘ACTIVE’, ‘INACTIVE’
